record.tooling: not stated on the page read: hourly billing with a web configurator and no documented API on the homepage; the tracker records IPv4 only and no IPv6 for this plan
record.chaining: a EUR 3 monthly cap with 4 TB of included transfer in Barcelona makes this a cheap EU egress point or a scheduler, and the EUR 5 signup credit covers a full month at the cap; 5 GB of disk and half a core exclude it from any storage or inference role

identity_cost.detail: Email and password only. The registration form renders two fields, 'Email' and 'Password', beneath the heading 'Give us a try for free, no strings attached.', then two consent ticks, and its button reads 'Create a free account'. The form carries no phone, card, country or identity-document field, and a balance gift is added at signup: 'Start with a 5€ gift to your balance upon signup.'
